items.title: Windows LPE Vulnerabilities via Kernel Drivers and Named Pipes Allows Privilege Escalation
items.description: Security researchers are increasingly focusing on privilege escalation attacks through two primary Windows attack surfaces: kernel drivers and named pipes. These vectors exploit fundamental trust boundary weaknesses between the user and kernel modes. Enabling attackers to escalate from standard user privileges to SYSTEM-level access. items.title: Fresh MongoDB Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
items.description: Dubbed MongoBleed, the high-severity flaw allows unauthenticated, remote attackers to leak sensitive information from MongoDB servers. The post Fresh MongoDB Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.
